en: Black‑and‑white elevated view over a historic European town with dense, steep‑roofed houses in the foreground and a large fortress‑like complex with towers and spires dominating the mid‑ground. A tall industrial chimney and a long factory building stand to the left, while wooded hills frame the background. Streets curve between the tightly packed old buildings; the architecture appears Central European, likely German-speaking, early 20th century.
